notes.recognition: The curved travel sweep and endpoint read clearly at 220 px but become intentionally quiet at 72 px.
notes.agency: The gold origin and cyan destination reinforce a committed route without inventing outcome UI.
notes.specificity: Mineral motes and the compass-to-survey color transition avoid a generic neon line.
notes.restraint: The effect occupies a small middle band and leaves almost the entire canvas transparent.
notes.continuity: Compass gold for choice and cyan for navigable destination preserve the semantic palette.
notes.reusability: Clean alpha and generous padding support additive board placement and responsive scaling.
notes.accessibility: Arc geometry survives without color, though the 72 px presentation needs sufficient contrast behind it.
